decks.summary: Mixed clue-and-combat Joe for Hard: Milan and Magnifying Glass for clues, Machete, the .45 and Beat Cop for enemies, and a hunch deck of Working a Hunch, Scene of the Crime and No Stone Unturned.
Draw-heavy Joe who plays Laboratory Assistants through Unearth the Ancients, keeps a big hand with Dream-Enhancing Serum, and answers enemies with One in the Chamber and "Fool me once...".

Pure solo Joe who recycles hunch events with Detective's Colt 1911s, discovers clues without tests through Working a Hunch, Scene of the Crime and Vantage Point, and hides behind Art Students and Maleson.
The first P.I. Staker: Joe for clues and combat, tested on Hard in Dunwich and Carcosa, with Milan, Magnifying Glass and Fingerprint Kit for clues and Machete and the .45 for enemies.
Money-saving Joe: Charles Ross makes Magnifying Glass, Fine Clothes and the .45 cheap or free, Fingerprint Kit and Deduction take clues, and Interrogate and Persuasion handle Humanoids.
A standard, efficient clue-first Joe: Milan, Magnifying Glass and Fingerprint Kit with Deduction, a hunch deck of No Stone Unturned and Scene of the Crime, and Machete for enemies.
True solo Joe whose Dream Diary covers his weak willpower and agility, with Mr. "Rook" and Astounding Revelation for money and tutoring and Enchanted Blade for enemies.
Police-themed Joe with Alice Luxley: testless clues from Working a Hunch, Scene of the Crime and Interrogate trigger her damage, and Handcuffs, Blackjack and Persuasion deal with Humanoids.
Combo fighter Joe who studies with Gray's Anatomy, Ancient Stone and Empirical Hypothesis for 8 damage off a (1) intellect test, set up by The Raven Quill.
Two-box Joe from the Revised Core and The Circle Undone: five guns, Milan and Magnifying Glass, Grisly Totem to boost commits, and Delay the Inevitable to survive.
